note: All field types must be enum|int|bool|hash. No string/free types allowed (privacy invariant §3.2). This file is the single source of truth for both the client redaction allowlist and the server schema codegen.

categories.name: command_usage
categories.description: Which CLI commands are used, how often, and how they complete. Never includes arguments or flag values — only verb + enumerated flag presence.

fields.name: verb
fields.description: Top-level subcommand verb

fields.name: exit_class
fields.description: Outcome class (not the numeric exit code)

fields.name: duration_bucket
fields.description: Wall-time bucket

categories.name: skill_activation
categories.description: Which skill was activated, from what surface, and whether it was accepted. Skill id is a salted hash of the skill manifest id — never the raw name.

fields.name: skill_id_hash
fields.description: Salted hash of the skill manifest id (install-salt; never the raw id)

fields.name: trigger_source
fields.description: How the skill was triggered

fields.name: accepted
fields.description: Whether the skill was included in the prompt (vs rejected/skipped)

fields.name: surface
fields.description: Which surface triggered the skill activation

categories.name: edit_pattern
categories.description: Operation type and file category for file edits performed by the agent. Never includes file contents, paths, or diffs.

fields.name: op_type
fields.description: Type of edit operation

fields.name: file_kind
fields.description: File extension class (not the filename)

fields.name: size_bucket
fields.description: Size of the change in lines

categories.name: harness_usage
categories.description: Tool-call mix and session shape per task. Counts and shapes only — never tool arguments or results.

fields.name: tool_call_kind
fields.description: Broad class of MCP tool called

fields.name: turns_bucket
fields.description: Number of LLM turns in the task

fields.name: agents_spawned_bucket
fields.description: Number of subagents spawned

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Execution mode

categories.name: error_surface
categories.description: Error class and subsystem, extending the existing `errors` category for cross-user aggregate analysis. Never includes error messages or stack traces.

fields.name: error_class
fields.description: Error class (not the message)

fields.name: subsystem
fields.description: Subsystem that produced the error

fields.name: recoverable
fields.description: Whether the error was recovered from (e.g. by retry)

categories.name: default_decision
categories.description: Tunable-constant decisions and their observed outcomes. Enables empirical default-setting across the user base. Decision id and chosen value are both enums — no raw numeric values.

fields.name: decision_id
fields.description: Which tunable constant was in effect

fields.name: chosen
fields.description: Bucketed chosen value (never the raw number)

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Observed outcome at that decision site

fields.name: magnitude_bucket
fields.description: Optional ordinal (0=minimal, 1=normal, 2=stressed, 3=extreme) for relative magnitude context

categories.name: research_metrics
categories.description: Research/benchmark metric events. Session prefix is an enum (not the full id); metric value is bucketed. No metadata_json, no raw session ids.

fields.name: session_prefix
fields.description: Prefix of the session id (colon-delimited; the suffix is hashed). Sourced from crates/vox-telemetry/src/types.rs SESSION_PREFIX_* constants (without the trailing colon); 'unknown' is the project_event() fallback for a session id with no colon.

fields.name: metric_type
fields.description: Type of metric. Verbatim list of every METRIC_TYPE_* constant defined in crates/vox-telemetry/src/types.rs. Note: several of these (model_call_event, task.root_summary, build.summary, telemetry.error, vox.lint.*, vox.repair.*, vox.audit.run, vox.model.*, vox.doctor.project_check) are emitted today via their own dedicated TelemetryEvent variants routed to other taxonomy categories (model_calls/build/errors/agent_orchestration) in crates/vox-telemetry-otlp/src/project.rs, not via the generic ResearchMetric path this category's emit_site names — included here for completeness of the allowlist, not as a claim that every value is exclusively research_metrics-routed.

fields.name: metric_value_bucket
fields.description: Rounded/bucketed metric value

categories.name: model_calls
categories.description: Per-LLM-call performance telemetry. Model/provider are enums. Token counts and latency are bucketed. No selection_rationale, trace_id, or caller_agent_id.

fields.name: model_id_hash
fields.description: Salted hash of the raw model identifier (open/growing set — new models are auto-discovered by the model-autonomic system, see docs/src/architecture/model-autonomic-system-2026.md — so this cannot be a bounded enum). NOTE: as of this writing, crates/vox-telemetry-otlp/src/project.rs (ModelCall arm) projects the raw `model` string verbatim under the old field name `model_id` with no hashing — this field name/type declares the intended contract; the project.rs code needs a follow-up change to actually hash before upload.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Provider name. Sourced from the match arms in crates/vox-config/src/resolve_egress.rs.

fields.name: duration_bucket
fields.description: Latency bucket

fields.name: prompt_tokens_bucket
fields.description: Prompt token count bucket

fields.name: completion_tokens_bucket
fields.description: Completion token count bucket

fields.name: error_class
fields.description: Error class if the call failed, absent otherwise. Reuses the same bounded set as the errors/error_surface categories (crates/vox-telemetry/src/types.rs ErrorSurfaceEvent doc comment).

fields.name: task
fields.description: Selection decision task tag. Real distinct premium_alias_key values from crates/vox-orchestrator/src/models/routing_table.rs ROUTING_TABLE — several TaskCategory variants (TypeChecking, General, Ars, ToolOrchestration, CodeEffortJudge, Chat) collapse onto 'logic'.

fields.name: chosen_model_id_hash
fields.description: Salted hash of the chosen model identifier for SelectionDecision events (same open-identifier rationale as model_id_hash). NOTE: project.rs currently projects this raw and unhashed under the old field name `chosen_model` — see model_id_hash note.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Selection reason tag (crates/vox-telemetry/src/types.rs SelectionDecisionEvent doc comment).

fields.name: source
fields.description: Discovery source (crates/vox-telemetry/src/types.rs DiscoveryEvent doc comment).

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Classification tier. ModelTier variants from contracts/orchestration/model-routing.v1.yaml `tiers`, lowercased (crates/vox-orchestrator/src/models/autonomic.rs).

fields.name: from_confidence
fields.description: Pre-promotion confidence tier (crates/vox-telemetry/src/types.rs ConfidencePromotionEvent doc comment).

fields.name: to_confidence
fields.description: Post-promotion confidence tier (same set as from_confidence).

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Promotion evidence tag (crates/vox-telemetry/src/types.rs ConfidencePromotionEvent doc comment).

categories.name: agent_orchestration
categories.description: Agent task and orchestration summary events. Counts are bucketed. No task_id, trace_id, or repository_id.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Task/run outcome class. Union of the real outcome vocabularies projected into this category in crates/vox-telemetry-otlp/src/project.rs: TaskRootSummaryEvent (completed|failed|doubted|cancelled), AuditRunEvent (ok|bar_missed|infra_error|invalid_input), DoctorProjectCheckEvent (green|red|infra_error).

fields.name: child_call_bucket
fields.description: Child call count bucket

fields.name: subagent_bucket
fields.description: Subagent fanout bucket

fields.name: fixture_kind
fields.description: AiFixture inner kind

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: Repair attempt number

fields.name: diagnostics_delta
fields.description: Diagnostics-in minus diagnostics-out (progress signal)

fields.name: success
fields.description: Whether the repair/run succeeded

fields.name: attempts_used
fields.description: Number of repair attempts used

fields.name: thing
fields.description: Audit subject tag — the `vox audit <thing>` gate name (crates/vox-telemetry/src/types.rs AuditRunEvent doc comment + the `vox audit` umbrella subcommands).

fields.name: passed
fields.description: Whether the check passed

categories.name: build
categories.description: Build and lint summary events. No file paths, build_id, or repository_id.

fields.name: exit_class
fields.description: Build outcome class. Sourced from BuildSummaryEvent.outcome (crates/vox-telemetry/src/types.rs doc comment); projected verbatim in crates/vox-telemetry-otlp/src/project.rs.

fields.name: duration_bucket
fields.description: Build wall-time bucket

fields.name: rule_id_hash
fields.description: Salted hash of the lint rule id (open/growing set spanning the whole compiler's detector catalog, e.g. `retired/decorator-usage` — cannot be a bounded enum). NOTE: crates/vox-telemetry-otlp/src/project.rs (LintFinding arm) currently projects the raw rule_id string verbatim under the old field name `rule_id` with no hashing — this field name/type declares the intended contract; the project.rs code needs a follow-up change to actually hash before upload.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Lint severity

fields.name: autofix_available
fields.description: Whether an autofix was available

categories.name: errors
categories.description: Subsystem error summary events. No trace_id, model, or provider free-form fields.

fields.name: subsystem
fields.description: Subsystem that produced the error. Same bounded set as error_surface.subsystem (crates/vox-telemetry/src/types.rs ErrorSurfaceEvent doc comment, whose own doc comment marks it 'category=errors'). NOTE: crates/vox-telemetry-otlp/src/project.rs also routes the older, free-form TelemetryEvent::Error (ErrorEvent — dot-separated subsystem paths like 'llm.http') into this same 'errors' category key; that arm is not bounded by this allowlist today and is a pre-existing gap, not something this JSON-only fix resolves.

fields.name: error_class
fields.description: Error class. Same bounded set as error_surface.error_class; see the subsystem field note about the ungated legacy ErrorEvent path.

fields.name: recoverable
fields.description: Whether the error was recovered from

categories.name: model_prompt
categories.description: Outcome of per-model prompt profile injection (Track F). Feeds the learned Model-Layer. All fields are enums/buckets — no raw prompt text ever uploaded.

fields.name: canonical_model_id
fields.description: Canonical model family (not the provider-specific alias)

fields.name: profile_variant_id
fields.description: Which profile variant was active (none = no profile injected)

fields.name: task_category
fields.description: Broad task category at prompt-build time

fields.name: quality_bucket
fields.description: Outcome quality bucket (derived from task completion signal); 'unknown' is emitted at prompt-build time before outcome is known
